meta.name: upgrade
meta.description: Upgrade the NotFair plugin to the latest version. Updates the marketplace repo, installs the new version to the plugin cache, and updates installed_plugins.json. Use when asked to "upgrade notfair", "update notfair", or "get latest version". Also handles inline upgrade prompts when a skill detects UPGRADE_AVAILABLE at startup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键升级 NotFair 插件到最新版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NotFair 插件并需要保持最新
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade NotFair plugin to the latest version with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NotFair plugin and need to keep it up to date

howto.what: Claude 会检查 NotFair 插件当前版本，从官方仓库拉取最新版，安装到缓存并更新记录，清理旧版本，最后列出新增内容。若检测到开发链接则跳过升级。
howto.when: 当你说“upgrade notfair”“update notfair”“get latest version”，或技能启动时检测到 UPGRADE_AVAILABLE 时，Claude 会执行升级。

say.note: Claude 会检查并安装最新版本。

say.text: 更新 NotFair 到最新版
say.note: 如有新版，会自动升级并展示更新内容。

say.text: 检查 NotFair 是否有更新
say.note: 若有新版则升级，否则提示已是最新。

howto.what_en: Claude will check the current NotFair plugin version, fetch the latest code from the marketplace, install it to the cache, update installed_plugins.json, clean up old versions, and list the new changes. It skips the upgrade if a dev symlink is detected.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'upgrade notfair', 'update notfair', or 'get latest version', or when a skill startup detects UPGRADE_AVAILABLE.

say_en.note: Claude will check and install the latest version.

say_en.text: Update NotFair to the latest version
say_en.note: It will perform the upgrade if a newer version exists.
If yes, it will upgrade and show what's new.
